data.one_liner: Widget that animates a single line of text with scale, opacity, transform, blur and rotation.
data.what_it_does: AnimateText is a StatefulWidget that displays a single line of text and applies per‑character animations such as sliding, fading, blurring, rotating or scaling. It supports multiple directions, speeds, curves and repeat options.
use_when: You need a quick, one‑line text animation for a splash screen or headline.
You want to add simple motion to a label without writing custom animation code.
avoid_when: You need multi‑line or paragraph animations.
You require complex, custom animation sequences that involve multiple widgets or physics.
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single line of code.
Offers many built‑in animation types and speed options.
weaknesses: Limited to a single line of text.
No support for custom animation curves beyond the provided ones.
Not suitable for complex animation chains.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a broader set of animation helpers for widgets, including text, and is actively maintained.
